requirejs.config.enableDefinitionProvide: Enables cross-module symbol lookup in the "Go to Definition" command.
requirejs.config.enableReferenceProvider: Enables cross-module symbol lookup in the "Find All References" command.
requirejs.config.enableCompletionItemPro: Enables selecting from the module directory content when typing "/" inside a string with a module path.
requirejs.config.enableHoverProvider: Enables displaying the file-system path, which the module path resolves to, when hovering with the mouse cursor above a string with a module path.
requirejs.config.enableRenameProvider: Enables cross-module symbol lookup in the "Rename Symbol" command.
requirejs.config.enableMixinCodeLensProv: Shows CodeLens labels above methods overridden by applied mixins.
requirejs.config.enableMixinDecorations: Highlights methods overridden by applied mixins and shows mixin details on hover.
requirejs.config.showGoToDefinitionModul: Shows the "Go to Definition Module" command in context menus.
requirejs.config.showRenameExportedSymbo: Shows the "Rename Exported Symbol" command in context menus.
requirejs.config.configFile: Path of the RequireJS configuration file relative to workspace root
requirejs.config.enableCjsModules: Parse source files as pure CommonJS modules
requirejs.config.enableJsxModules: Enable support for the JSX language extension
requirejs.config.enableEsModules: Enable detection of ES modules in addition to AMD or CJS modules
requirejs.config.moduleCacheSize: Maximum count of parsed modules and their dependencies kept in memory as cache to improve performance
requirejs.config.dynamicModuleCacheSize: Make cache sizes depend on the count of JavaScript modules in the project
requirejs.config.dynamicModuleCacheSizeE: How many percent of the JavaScript module count should be reserved not to exhaust the cache so quickly
requirejs.config.includeModulePattern: File globbing pattern to find JavaScript modules in this project
requirejs.config.excludeModulePattern: File globbing pattern to exclude when looking for JavaScript modules in this project
requirejs.config.cutFileCompletionExtens: File extensions to cut, if the file name is offered in module path completion
requirejs.config.includeFileCompletionEx: Only the specified file extensions will be included for module path completion; all will be included, if empty
requirejs.config.excludeFileCompletionEx: The specified file extensions will not be included for module path completion
requirejs.config.modulePath: Module path relative to workspace root
requirejs.config.onlyNavigateToFile: When set to true, it will prevent the final search for the identifier in the landing module and instead just reference the file.
requirejs.config.lookupMaxLevels: Maximum number of parent levels to search in inherited modules for module identifiers, this.member and this._super lookups
requirejs.config.observableDeclarationMe: Method names where observable assignments like this.member = ... should be recognized
requirejs.config.mixinConfigSearchPatter: Workspace-relative glob patterns used to search requirejs-config.js files for applied mixins
requirejs.config.pluginExtensions: Assigns default file extensions to target module paths used with RequireJS plugins
requirejs.config.moduleProcessingBatchSi: How many documents should be opened and searched before cancelling of the operation is possible
